title: Robert Thorson, The Walden Experiments -- The Science of Henry David Thoreau

title: Book TV
description: This long-running staple of the C-SPAN2 weekend schedule helps expand the channel's programming beyond politics. Most episodes of "Book TV" feature discussions with authors of nonfiction books, usually in the form of interviews, lectures or seminars. The series sometimes includes coverage of major book fairs and festivals. Some of the notable names who have appeared on the show include David Mamet and Tom Clancy.

title: George Rogers Clark in the Revolutionary War -- 1978
description: This 1978 U.S. Department of the Interior film portrays Revolutionary War hero George Rogers Clark and his service in the western frontier; "Reel America" is an American History TV series featuring 20th-century archival films.

title: America 250
description: An up-close look at the oldest American fighting vessel in existence, the Gunboat Philadelphia, as it undergoes a multi-year conservation treatment at the Smithsonian National Museum of American History in Washington, D.C.

title: America 250
description: Journalist Judy Woodruff, who covered the Jimmy Carter presidency for NBC News, reflects on the life and legacy of First Lady Rosalynn Carter (1977-81). Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to mark the nation's 250th birthd.

title: America 250
description: Political commentator David Brooks reflects on the life and legacy of Ronald Reagan, America's 40th president (1981-89). His essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to mark the nation's 250th birthday in 2026.
